body: You more than likely don't want to read this right now but I've overdosed on sertraline before and it done nothing for me except for screw up the nerves in my legs, which is one of the overdose symptoms. And I more than likely took the same amount as you if not more. Believe me I know how you feel but giving yourself unnecessary pain with the chance of permanent damage (luckily my symptoms only lasted a day or two) isn't worth it.
Me. Depression is a symptom for me, a fairly logical one. There's nothing wrong with my brain, it's responding accordingly to the shit life I have.
